user.title: Zaya Planner
user.description: Add the planner. Automations and scripts make plans with zaya_planner.add_step and zaya_planner.set_plan; plans are shown on the “Plans” calendar.

data_description.lateness_hours: A plan whose first step cannot start this late (for example after Home Assistant was off) fails.
data_description.action_prefix: Only scripts whose entity id starts with this prefix can be steps, for example script.step_ (planning modules are script.plan_).
data_description.retention_days: Finished plans older than this are removed.
data_description.notify_action: Action that sends notifications about failed plans and errors in events, for example notify.mobile_app_phone or a script with title and message fields. Empty: a notification in Home Assistant.
data_description.calendars: The calendars Zaya Planner reads. Other calendars are never opened, and nothing is written to these.
data_description.tags: Tags that may be written in event descriptions, without “#”: leaf, отвезти… A tag starts with a letter.
data_description.keys: Keys of “Key: value” lines in event descriptions, for example “В пути”. Lines with other keys are notes.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must start with “script.” and name a group of scripts, for example script.step_
error.invalid_action: Write an action as domain.action, for example notify.mobile_app_phone
error.invalid_tag: A tag starts with a letter and has only letters, digits, “_” and “-”.
error.invalid_key: A key cannot have “:” or start with “#”.

user.title: Calendar sensor
user.description: The time of events with tags: their start or end, minus or plus an offset. For example, “Leaf trips”: events with #leaf, their start minus “Travel”. The sensor shows the next time; with a horizon it also lists every time within it.

data.name: Name
data.first_of_day: Only the first of the day

data_description.name: The name of the sensor, e.g. “Leaf trips” → sensor.leaf_trips.
data_description.tags: The event has all these tags (from the dictionary in the integration settings).
data_description.exclude_tags: The event has none of these tags, e.g. #self.
data_description.calendars: Events of these calendars only, e.g. the children's calendars, or “Plans” for marks. Empty: all the chosen calendars.
data_description.offset_key: The key whose value in the event is the offset, e.g. “Travel: 00:40:00”. Empty: always the default offset.
data_description.default_offset: The offset when the event does not give it (0: the time of the event itself); such events are listed in “Errors in events”.
data_description.horizon: List every time within this period from now in the “times” attribute: “Plan marks” and “Turn on for a while” make a plan for each. Empty: only the next time.
data_description.first_of_day: Only the first event of each day.

reconfigure.title: Change calendar sensor
reconfigure.description: The time of events with tags: their start or end, minus or plus an offset. For example, “Leaf trips”: events with #leaf, their start minus “Travel”. The sensor shows the next time; with a horizon it also lists every time within it.

data.name: Name
data.first_of_day: Only the first of the day

data_description.name: The name of the sensor, e.g. “Leaf trips” → sensor.leaf_trips.
data_description.tags: The event has all these tags (from the dictionary in the integration settings).
data_description.exclude_tags: The event has none of these tags, e.g. #self.
data_description.calendars: Events of these calendars only, e.g. the children's calendars, or “Plans” for marks. Empty: all the chosen calendars.

data_description.horizon: List every time within this period from now in the “times” attribute: “Plan marks” and “Turn on for a while” make a plan for each. Empty: only the next time.

options.start: for the start of the event
options.end: for the end of the event

add_step.name: Add step
add_step.description: Adds a step to the plan being made in this run. The time is one of: the time of an entity, the time of an event, a date and time; without a time the step is left out. Call “Set plan” after the steps.

at_entity.name: Time of
at_entity.description: The time an entity shows: Sun “Next sunset”, a timestamp sensor, a date-and-time helper.

event.name: Event
event.description: The next event of the chosen calendars that fits this filter: #tag, Key: value, Key.

subtract.name: Minus attribute
subtract.description: A key whose value is a duration (Travel: 40:00): the time is the event's start minus it.

at.name: Date and time
at.description: A date and time, or a template.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Minutes later; minus: earlier (−30: half an hour before).

devices.name: Devices
devices.description: Turn these devices on or off and wait until they confirm.

action.name: Script
action.description: Instead of devices: a step script that answers ok and reason.

set_plan.name: Set plan
set_plan.description: Makes the steps added in this run the owner's next plan, replacing the one there was. With no steps it cancels the next plan. A frozen or running plan is not changed; a plan whose first step is in the past is not made (result past).

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Usually not needed: the automation or script that started this run. Shown in advanced mode.

summary.name: Summary
summary.description: Name of the plan on the calendar.

on_failure.name: On failure
on_failure.description: Script run if the plan fails, with the fields plan, step, reason and done.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Steps given as a list (YAML) instead of “Add step”.

force.name: Force
force.description: A change by a person: also replace a frozen plan.

display.name: On the calendar
display.description: One event from the first step to the last, or a short event for each step.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags from the dictionary, without “#”: to freeze or unfreeze plans together.

cancel_plan.name: Cancel plan
cancel_plan.description: Cancels the owner's next plan. Frozen and running plans stay unless forced.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Usually not needed: the automation or script that started this run. Shown in advanced mode.

force.name: Force
force.description: A choice of a person: also cancel frozen and running plans.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Only the plans of this owner.

ensure_state.name: Turn on/off and confirm
ensure_state.description: Turns devices on or off and waits until each one reports the new state. Answers ok and reason.

find_events.name: Find events
find_events.description: Finds events of the chosen calendars by tags and attributes. Answers each event with its tags and attributes (as text).

filter.name: Filter
filter.description: One condition per line: #tag (the tag is there), !#tag (it is not), Key: value (the attribute has this value), Key (the attribute is there). Empty: all events.

calendars.name: Calendars
calendars.description: Some of the chosen calendars. Empty: all chosen calendars.

start.name: From
start.description: Start of the period. Empty: now.

end.name: To
end.description: End of the period. Empty: 8 days from the start.

first_of_day.name: First of each day
first_of_day.description: Only the first matching event of each day.

only_future.name: Only future
only_future.description: Only events whose time (the start, or the start minus the attribute) has not come yet.

subtract.name: Minus attribute
subtract.description: A key from the dictionary whose value is a duration (e.g. Travel: 40:00): the time of an event (at) is its start minus it.

plan_window.name: Turn on for a while
plan_window.description: A plan of two steps: turn the devices on at the start and off at the end. The start and the end are times of entities plus minutes. When both are the same calendar sensor with a horizon, a plan for each of its times (overlapping ones become one). If the end is before the start (e.g. at night), nothing is planned.

devices.name: Devices
devices.description: One or more: switches, lights, input booleans…

start_entity.name: Start
start_entity.description: The time of an entity: Sun “Next sunset”, a timestamp sensor, a time helper.

end_entity.name: End
end_entity.description: The time of an entity, e.g. Sun “Next sunrise”.

summary.name: Name
summary.description: Name of the plan. Empty: the names of the devices.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags from the dictionary, without “#”: to freeze or unfreeze plans together.

display.name: On the calendar
display.description: A short event for each step, or one event from the start to the end.

plan_marks.name: Plan marks
plan_marks.description: A mark on the “Plans” calendar at the time of each entity plus minutes: “Departure — School 07:20”. From a calendar sensor with a horizon, a mark at each time it lists. The times of all the entities make one set: marks that are there stay, new ones are made, marks of times that are gone are cancelled; frozen marks and marks a person moved or deleted are not touched.

summary.name: Name
summary.description: Name of the marks, e.g. Departure. Empty: the name of the event.

time_entity.name: Time of
time_entity.description: Entities with a time: calendar sensors (e.g. “take there” and “pick up”), Sun “Next sunrise”, a date and time helper. Their times make one set of marks.

add_location.name: Add the location
add_location.description: Add the event's location to the name: “Departure — School”.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags from the dictionary, without “#”: to find the marks and to freeze them.

freeze_plans.name: Freeze plans
freeze_plans.description: Freezes the planned plans with any of these tags (empty: all) that start within the hours given. After that automations cannot change or cancel them; a person still can, in the Plans calendar.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags of the plans, without “#”. Empty: all plans.

within_hours.name: Start within
within_hours.description: Only plans that start within this many hours.

unfreeze_plans.name: Unfreeze plans
unfreeze_plans.description: Unfreezes the frozen plans with any of these tags (empty: all) that have not started: their owners may change them again.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tags of the plans, without “#”. Empty: all plans.

not_loaded.message: Zaya Planner is not set up.

action_not_allowed.message: {action} cannot be a step: a step runs zaya_planner.ensure_state or a script starting with {prefix}.

state_required.message: Choose the state (on or off) for the devices.

steps_not_in_order.message: The steps are not in time order.

plan_not_open.message: There is no such open plan.

plan_started.message: The plan has started: it can be cancelled but not moved.

not_a_chosen_calendar.message: Zaya Planner does not read {calendars}: choose it in the integration settings.

unknown_filter_words.message: Not in the dictionary: {words}. Add them in the integration settings.

end_before_start.message: The end of the period is not after its start.

owner_unknown.message: Whose plan is it? Called outside an automation or script, give the owner.

one_time_source.message: Give the time of a step one way: an entity, an event, or a date and time.
